# Purpose and decision rules

This report is a **source-screening document** only. The purpose is to review and assess publicly available data, gathered by local and regional agencies, to support future assessments of *Mytilus trossulus*' response to environmental conditions. The data in this report was taken from the WA Department of Ecology (DoE)

**Stages:** inventory → structural validation → data quality → descriptive EDA → sampling coverage → depth/season/site characterization → suitability decision. The current pilot uses two derived tables from the same DoE NetCDF file groups. 

**QC boundary:** The default `apply_qc: false` means all outputs are *provisional*. All posted data is QC'd by DoE, therefore the QC flags are only for my future intended use.

**Sampling units:** Depth observations are nested within profiles; profiles are nested within stations and time. Nutrients are discrete samples at selected depths. The source webpage lists units for profile parameters and all five discrete nutrients (including phosphate at µM); correspondence between the webpage and the extracted NetCDF variables still requires confirmation.

# A. Setup, source registration and file checks

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)

source_id <- params$source_id
source_label <- params$source_label
output_dir <- params$output_dir
fig_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

inputs <- c(abiotic = params$abiotic_file, nutrients = params$nutrient_file)
missing_inputs <- inputs[!file.exists(inputs)]
if (length(missing_inputs)) {
  stop("Missing input(s): ", paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "),
       ". Change paths in YAML params or render from the project root.")
}

# Keep a basic, auditable source registry; augment manually with agency details.
source_registry <- tibble(
  source_id = source_id,
  source_label = source_label,
  provider = "Washington Department of Ecology",
  platform = "EIM",
  source_family = "Marine water profiles and nutrients",
  raw_format = "NetCDF (.nc)",
  derived_files = paste(basename(inputs), collapse = "; "),
  source_url = NA_character_,
  download_date = NA_character_,
  spatial_reference = "Station coordinates (validate datum/CRS)",
  temporal_resolution = "Repeated sampling profiles",
  vertical_reference = "Meters below surface (verify yearly metadata)",
  units_verified = FALSE, # webpage units recorded; per-file attributes not yet verified
  qc_reviewed = FALSE,
  responsible_reviewer = NA_character_,
  notes = "Pilot screening; complete registry fields from original metadata"
)
write_csv(source_registry, file.path(output_dir, "source_registry.csv"))
source_registry %>% kable()
```

## A1. Read the two working tables

```{r}
#| label: import
abiotic_raw <- read_csv(params$abiotic_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
nutrient_raw <- read_csv(params$nutrient_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

abiotic_vars <- c("temperature", "salinity", "dissolved_oxygen")
nutrient_vars <- c("nitrate", "nitrite", "ammonium", "phosphate", "silicate")
keys <- c("station_name", "profile_index", "depth_m", "field_date")

check_columns <- function(data, expected, table_name) {
  absent <- setdiff(expected, names(data))
  if (length(absent)) stop(table_name, " missing columns: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}
check_columns(abiotic_raw, c(keys, abiotic_vars), "abiotic")
check_columns(nutrient_raw, c(keys, nutrient_vars), "nutrients")

# Preserve the imported tables untouched. Work on independently named copies.
standardize <- function(df, value_names) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      field_date = as.Date(field_date),
      sample_year = year(field_date),
      month = month(field_date),
      month_label = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
      station_name = as.character(station_name),
      profile_index = as.character(profile_index),
      # Include source and year so annual profile IDs do not collide.
      profile_uid = paste(source_id, sample_year, profile_index, sep = "__"),
      across(all_of(c("depth_m", value_names)), as.numeric)
    )
}
abiotic <- standardize(abiotic_raw, abiotic_vars)
nutrients <- standardize(nutrient_raw, nutrient_vars)

# A date parse failure would produce a fabricated year of NA; don't continue silently.
if (anyNA(abiotic$field_date) || anyNA(nutrients$field_date)) {
  warning("Unparsed/missing dates exist: investigate before temporal summaries.")
}

tibble(table = c("abiotic", "nutrients"),
       rows = c(nrow(abiotic), nrow(nutrients)),
       stations = c(n_distinct(abiotic$station_name), n_distinct(nutrients$station_name)),
       profiles = c(n_distinct(abiotic$profile_uid), n_distinct(nutrients$profile_uid))) %>% kable()
```

## A2. Identifier and duplication audit

```{r}
#| label: keys-audit
# Repeated profile IDs across depth observations are EXPECTED.
# Exact duplicated rows and conflicting station/profile assignments are not.
key_audit <- function(x, table_name) {
  tibble(
    table = table_name,
    exact_duplicate_rows = sum(duplicated(x)),
    missing_station = sum(is.na(x$station_name) | x$station_name == ""),
    missing_profile = sum(is.na(x$profile_index)),
    missing_date = sum(is.na(x$field_date)),
    missing_depth = sum(is.na(x$depth_m)),
    negative_depth = sum(x$depth_m < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    profile_station_conflicts = x %>%
      filter(!is.na(profile_uid), !is.na(station_name)) %>%
      distinct(profile_uid, station_name) %>%
      count(profile_uid) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow()
  )
}
keys_report <- bind_rows(key_audit(abiotic, "abiotic"),
                         key_audit(nutrients, "nutrients"))
write_csv(keys_report, file.path(output_dir, "identifier_audit.csv"))
keys_report %>% kable()
```

# B. QC review and data integrity (pre-cleaning)
## B1. Variable dictionary to complete
The Ecology marine-water data webpage lists nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, and silicate in micromolar (µM), not µg/L. The phosphate unit was confirmed by the user from the portion of the webpage outside the screenshot. Units below are documented webpage units, pending verification against individual NetCDF variable attributes and any year-specific differences. No numeric unit conversion is performed.

```{r}
#| label: dictionary
variable_dictionary <- tibble(
  variable = c(abiotic_vars, nutrient_vars),
  source_variable = c("Temp", "Salinity", "DOAdjusted", "NO3", "NO2", "NH4", "PO4", "SiOH4"),
  category = c(rep("abiotic sensor", 3), rep("discrete nutrient", 5)),
  unit = c("°C", "PSU", "mg/L", "µM", "µM", "µM", "µM", "µM"),
  unit_source = c(rep("Ecology webpage: profile parameters", 3),
                  "Ecology webpage: discrete nutrients",
                  "Ecology webpage: discrete nutrients",
                  "Ecology webpage: discrete nutrients",
                  "Ecology webpage: discrete nutrients (user confirmed)",
                  "Ecology webpage: discrete nutrients"),
  qc_field = NA_character_,
  accepted_qc_definition = NA_character_,
  reporting_limit = NA_real_,
  measurement_method = NA_character_,
  year_changes = NA_character_,
  review_status = "Webpage unit found; verify against NetCDF metadata"
)
write_csv(variable_dictionary, file.path(output_dir, "variable_dictionary_TO_COMPLETE.csv"))
variable_dictionary %>% kable()

# Plot facets display source-reported units; no value conversion occurs.
unit_lookup <- setNames(variable_dictionary$unit, variable_dictionary$variable)
facet_variable_labels <- function(x) {
  u <- unname(unit_lookup[as.character(x)])
  paste0(x, " (", u, ")")
}
```

## B2. Missing, sentinel, non-finite and negative value audit
### Note: nutrients are sampled at specific depths and cycles rather than at every depth and repeatedly throughout the year - 'missing' records does not mean missing in the same way that the water quality parameters are missing.
Sentinel values are those like -999 that represent a missing, invalid, or measurement tool limitation. Non-finite are values like NA, and require further review to confirm, and negative values may or may not be valid based on the measurement category, so it is flagged for review.

```{r}
#| label: missingness
# Do not mistake a physically plausible zero for missingness.
# Use numeric sentinels for diagnostics only until metadata confirms their meaning.
safe_stats <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(tibble(n_valid = 0L, min = NA_real_, q25 = NA_real_,
                                median = NA_real_, mean = NA_real_, q75 = NA_real_,
                                max = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_))
  tibble(n_valid = length(x), min = min(x), q25 = unname(quantile(x, .25)),
         median = median(x), mean = mean(x), q75 = unname(quantile(x, .75)),
         max = max(x), sd = if (length(x) > 1) sd(x) else NA_real_)
}

variable_audit <- function(df, vars, table_name) {
  df %>%
    select(sample_year, all_of(vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(sample_year, variable) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      z <- .x$value
      bind_cols(
        tibble(n_records = length(z),
               n_missing_na = sum(is.na(z)),
               n_nonfinite = sum(!is.finite(z)),
               n_sentinel = sum(!is.na(z) & z %in% params$missing_sentinels),
               n_negative = sum(z < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
               pct_nonfinite = round(mean(!is.finite(z)) * 100, 2)),
        safe_stats(replace(z, !is.na(z) & z %in% params$missing_sentinels, NA_real_))
      )
    }) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(table = table_name, .before = 1)
}
qa_audit <- bind_rows(variable_audit(abiotic, abiotic_vars, "abiotic"),
                      variable_audit(nutrients, nutrient_vars, "nutrients"))
write_csv(qa_audit, file.path(output_dir, "variable_year_quality_and_stats.csv"))
qa_audit %>% kable(digits = 2)
```

### Missing(ness) heatmap

```{r}
#| label: missing-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
p_missing <- qa_audit %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(sample_year), y = variable, fill = pct_nonfinite)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ table, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "% missing", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(title = "Missing or non-finite observations by variable and year",
       x = "Year", y = NULL) + theme_minimal()
print(p_missing)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "missing_by_year.png"), p_missing, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```

## B3. QC status and data cleaning

QC status for this project has not been defined. As stated earlier, all data hosted on DoE's sites has been QC'd or is indicated otherwise in the study description.

```{r}
#| label: qc-gate
# QC filter is intentionally disabled unless EVERY target variable has a
# documented, matching <variable>_qc column in its table.
apply_variable_qc <- function(df, vars, approved_codes) {
  needed <- paste0(vars, "_qc")
  check_columns(df, needed, "QC application")
  for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
    value_var <- vars[i]; qc_var <- needed[i]
    df[[value_var]][!is.na(df[[qc_var]]) & !(df[[qc_var]] %in% approved_codes)] <- NA_real_
    # Missing QC status stays unresolved rather than implicitly passing.
    df[[value_var]][is.na(df[[qc_var]])] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

if (isTRUE(params$apply_qc)) {
  # Only enable after confirming each variable's accepted values are correct.
  abiotic_qc <- apply_variable_qc(abiotic, abiotic_vars, params$accepted_qc_codes)
  nutrients_qc <- apply_variable_qc(nutrients, nutrient_vars, params$accepted_qc_codes)
} else {
  abiotic_qc <- abiotic
  nutrients_qc <- nutrients
  # Source data remain unchanged; any analyst-level screening is described in text.
}
# Keep QC scope in the report metadata, not embedded in every plot.
qc_label <- if (isTRUE(params$apply_qc)) {
  "Analyst-screened using explicitly configured codes"
} else {
  "No additional analyst QC filtering applied"
}
cat("**Analyst screening status:**", qc_label, "\n")
```

# C. Distributions (raw data)

```{r}
#| label: distribution-function
plot_variable_histograms <- function(df, vars, label) {
  df %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    filter(is.finite(value), !(value %in% params$missing_sentinels)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#0072B2", color = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(variable = facet_variable_labels)) +
    labs(title = paste(label, "measurement distributions"),
         x = "Value (units displayed in facet labels)",
         y = "Observation count") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

# D. Sampling coverage (before comparing concentrations)

## D1. Abiotic profile counts by station and year

```{r}
#| label: sampling-coverage
# A profile counts once, regardless of how many depth-bin observations it contains.
abiotic_coverage <- abiotic_qc %>%
  filter(!is.na(station_name), !is.na(profile_uid)) %>%
  group_by(station_name, sample_year) %>%
  summarise(n_profiles = n_distinct(profile_uid),
            n_months_sampled = n_distinct(month, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_depth_records = n(), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(abiotic_coverage, file.path(output_dir, "abiotic_station_year_coverage.csv"))

p_coverage <- ggplot(abiotic_coverage,
                    aes(factor(sample_year), fct_rev(station_name), fill = n_profiles)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Profiles") +
  labs(title = "Number of distinct abiotic profiles", x = "Year", y = "Station") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_coverage)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "abiotic_station_year_effort.png"),
       p_coverage, width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 200)

# Separate month-level profile coverage is more informative than a total alone.
abiotic_month_coverage <- abiotic_qc %>%
  group_by(station_name, sample_year, month) %>%
  summarise(n_profiles = n_distinct(profile_uid), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(abiotic_month_coverage, file.path(output_dir, "abiotic_station_year_month_coverage.csv"))
```

# E. Post-QC environmental patterns

**Interpretive boundary:** These are exploratory summaries of Ecology-hosted measurements, not an additional Ecology QC determination. Analyst-level screening of suitability, NetCDF metadata, unit consistency, and sampling coverage remains incomplete. Do not treat these summaries as validated exposure covariates until that review is complete. This limitation is documented here rather than repeated on individual plots.

## E1. Abiotic profile-level summaries: 0–13 m

```{r}
#| label: profile-summary
valid_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !(x %in% params$missing_sentinels)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_real_ else mean(x)
}
valid_min <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !(x %in% params$missing_sentinels)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_real_ else min(x)
}
valid_max <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !(x %in% params$missing_sentinels)]
  if (!length(x)) NA_real_ else max(x)
}

abiotic_rope <- abiotic_qc %>%
  filter(between(depth_m, params$rope_min_m, params$rope_max_m))

abiotic_profile <- abiotic_rope %>%
  group_by(station_name, profile_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    field_date = first(field_date),
    sample_year = first(sample_year), month = first(month),
    shallowest_m = valid_min(depth_m), deepest_m = valid_max(depth_m),
    n_depth_bins = n_distinct(depth_m),
    n_temp = sum(is.finite(temperature)),
    n_salinity = sum(is.finite(salinity) & !(salinity %in% params$missing_sentinels)),
    n_do = sum(is.finite(dissolved_oxygen) & !(dissolved_oxygen %in% params$missing_sentinels)),
    temperature_mean = valid_mean(temperature),
    temperature_range = if (sum(is.finite(temperature) & !(temperature %in% params$missing_sentinels)) > 0)
      valid_max(temperature) - valid_min(temperature) else NA_real_,
    salinity_mean = valid_mean(salinity),
    do_mean = valid_mean(dissolved_oxygen),
    do_min = valid_min(dissolved_oxygen),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(reaches_10m = deepest_m >= 10,
         reaches_12m = deepest_m >= 12,
         analyst_screening_status = qc_label)
write_csv(abiotic_profile, file.path(output_dir, "abiotic_profile_summaries.csv"))
```

**Caution:** A profile reaching 12 m is not automatically well represented at every intermediate depth. Inspect number and spacing of bins and missingness per variable; profile means from incomplete sections of the rope can be biased. Depth-bin statistics are exploratory until coverage rules are set.

```{r}

profile_long <- abiotic_profile %>%
  select(station_name, sample_year, month, profile_uid,

  pivot_longer(c(temperature_mean, salinity_mean, do_mean),

p_month <- ggplot(profile_long,

             })) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal distributions of profile means (pooled stations)",

  theme_minimal()
print(p_month)
```

## E3. Depth strata: vertical exposure structure

```{r}
#| label: depth-binning
# Bounds: [0,2], (2,5], (5,9], (9,13]. This is a candidate scheme, not a biological fact.
abiotic_depth <- abiotic_rope %>%
  mutate(depth_bin = cut(depth_m, breaks = c(0, 2, 5, 9, 13),
                         labels = c("0–2 m", "2–5 m", "5–9 m", "9–13 m"),
                         right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE))

abiotic_profile_depth <- abiotic_depth %>%
  filter(!is.na(depth_bin)) %>%
  group_by(station_name, profile_uid, sample_year, month, depth_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depth_bins = n_distinct(depth_m),
    temp_mean = valid_mean(temperature),
    salinity_mean = valid_mean(salinity),
    do_mean = valid_mean(dissolved_oxygen),
    do_min = valid_min(dissolved_oxygen),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write_csv(abiotic_profile_depth, file.path(output_dir, "abiotic_profile_depth_bin.csv"))

monthly_depth <- abiotic_profile_depth %>%
  group_by(month, depth_bin) %>%
  summarise(median_temp = if (any(is.finite(temp_mean)))
              median(temp_mean[is.finite(temp_mean)]) else NA_real_,
            n_profiles = sum(is.finite(temp_mean)), .groups = "drop")

p_depth_month <- ggplot(monthly_depth,
                        aes(factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb),
                            depth_bin, fill = median_temp)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90", name = "°C") +
  labs(title = "Seasonal temperature by depth stratum",
       subtitle = "Median of profile-bin means",
       x = "Month", y = "Depth bin") + theme_minimal()
print(p_depth_month)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "depth_bin_month_temperature.png"), p_depth_month,
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 200)
```

# F. Screening decision and handoff

**Do not collapse sources into an integrated environmental profile yet.** First decide whether each source supports (1) regional environmental characterization, (2) station-specific characterization, and/or (3) linkage to existing mussel records. These are separate suitability decisions.

```{r}
#| label: decision-templates
screening_decision <- tibble(
  source_id = source_id,
  data_family = c("abiotic", "nutrients"),
  qc_complete = FALSE,
  units_harmonized = FALSE,
  methods_comparable_across_years = NA,
  station_crosswalk_available = NA,
  spatial_coverage_assessed = FALSE,
  seasonal_coverage_assessed = FALSE,
  depth_compatibility_assessed = FALSE,
  regional_characterization = "pending",
  station_level_characterization = "pending",
  direct_mussel_linkage = "pending",
  decision_rationale = NA_character_,
  reviewer = NA_character_,
  review_date = NA_character_
)
write_csv(screening_decision, file.path(output_dir, "inclusion_decision_TO_COMPLETE.csv"))

undergrad_followup <- tibble(
  task_id = paste0("T", sprintf("%02d", 1:7)),
  task = c(
    "Locate and archive original annual source documentation and stable download links",
    "Verify variable units, methods, QC flags and changes across years",
    "Re-extract QC codes and qualifiers into year-level data tables",
    "Investigate suspect negatives, sentinels and duplicate identifiers",
    "Evaluate station/season/depth gaps and profile completeness",
    "Join station identifier crosswalk with provenance and ambiguous matches flagged",
    "Write a short suitability assessment for each intended application"
  ),
  status = "not started",
  evidence_link = NA_character_,
  notes = NA_character_
)
write_csv(undergrad_followup, file.path(output_dir, "undergrad_followup_tasks.csv"))
```

## F1. Analyst completion checklist

- [ ] Source URL, retrieval date, version, spatial reference and methods recorded.
- [ ] Original data preserved without destructive alterations.
- [ ] Station identifiers resolved; station coordinates and positional uncertainty reviewed.
- [ ] All relevant QC variables and codes interpreted using source documentation.
- [ ] Sentinels, missing values and censored results distinguished.
- [ ] Measurement units reconciled across annual files and across agencies.
- [ ] Duplicate and profile/station identifier anomalies checked.
- [ ] Temporal and seasonal sampling effort described; years with method changes flagged.
- [ ] Sampling depth and rope-relevant depth coverage evaluated independently.
- [ ] Histograms, descriptive tables and sampling-effort plots reviewed and annotated.
- [ ] Inclusion decisions recorded separately for regional, station and mussel-linked work.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up tasks documented for future researchers.

## F2. Expansion to 30+ other source files

For each new data source, **copy and rename this QMD** or parameterize its input stage; do not force different observation structures into the Ecology schema without a mapping step. The following columns provide a stable conceptual interface across sources: `source_id`, `provider`, `station_id`, `timestamp`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `depth_m` (if applicable), `variable`, `value`, `unit`, `quality_flag`, `method`, and `original_record_id`. Retain agency-specific fields in supplemental tables rather than discarding them.

A robust central **source inventory** should hold one row per source/version; the **variable dictionary** should hold one row per variable/measurement method; and an **inclusion decision** should exist per source *and intended use*. The station-code crosswalk is a separate, version-controlled table with explicit match confidence and provenance.

For undergraduate handoff, a practical initial deliverable for every source is: (i) completed registry, (ii) metadata and QC interpretation, (iii) missingness/coverage figures, (iv) descriptive plots, (v) one-page suitability memo, and (vi) unresolved questions with links to evidence.
